# Learning Notes

## How to write an entry
For each task, write 3-5 sentences in my own words: what I built,
why it exists, and one thing I learned.

---

## Phase 7: Git workflow
- main is the working version. Branches let me work on one task safely.
- A pull request is a review step before work joins main.
- .gitignore keeps secrets like .env out of GitHub.
- Commit messages follow "type: description" so history is readable.
